title: NAMES-REALISM-01 — item-level residence evidence ledger (research only)
semantics: Eligible names are those attested among country residents; linguistic/ethnic origin is irrelevant. This ledger tracks evidence quality, not ethnic identity or population calibration.

categories.direct_resident_biography: An independently located biographical source explicitly names a bearer and says they resided in the country at a stated/historical time; not necessarily the catalog's original row.
categories.territorial_model: A third-party modeled surname-incidence table lists the exact string in the country/city. Indirect aggregate evidence of reported geographic occurrence; not official registration or individual resident proof.
categories.country_index_only: A third-party surname index associates the string with the country but does not provide independently checked residence records.
categories.citizenship_only: A source indicates citizenship-associated name data but does not establish residence among people living in the country.
categories.catalog_only: The source catalog lists the name without an independently validated residence attestation for that country's resident population.

approval: No changes to source name lists, existing uniform surname sampling, weighted given names, or conditional 50/15/25/10 nationality-source probabilities.
original_catalog_item_row_source_links: absent in all 8,000 surveyed surname entries
